exclude_rules.why: These conflict with the local guide, which is authoritative for cluster-specific facts.
AI/GPU software changes quickly; stale install commands produce broken environments.
Not authoritative enough for a maintainable RAG corpus unless manually curated as known-error notes.
Admin instructions confuse end users and may encourage unsupported privileged operations.
Useful as secondary references but too dense/noisy for first-pass user answers.
Usually irrelevant to shared HPC and may encourage unsupported workflows.
HPC users generally cannot install drivers on cluster nodes; local admins control the driver stack.
Adds retrieval noise for most user-support questions; ingest selected task sections first.
Often contain stale screenshots, cluster-specific commands, embedded images, and poor text extraction.
